# Synthetic import fixtures

All files in this folder were created for Project.Rota tests. Alice, the organization and timetable are fictional. The DOCX/PPTX/XLSX originals were created with python-docx, python-pptx and openpyxl; DOC/PPT/XLS/PDF were exported with local LibreOffice. PNG and CSV are synthetic. These fixture-generation tools are not runtime dependencies and are never used to interpret user uploads.

The fixtures exercise actual browser format readers, embedded images and a merged spreadsheet cell. They do not establish compatibility with every Office variant or damaged/encrypted document.
